_comment: #74 Deep variants. Corrupted monsters: from first_depth a share of the floor's monsters (share + share_per_depth x (depth - first_depth), at most share_max; a seeded roll per monster) are corrupted: one ability from the pool by weight, health x hp_mult, damage x damage_mult, the name prefix, the tint and the aura, and better loot (loot: drop_mult, gold_mult, rarity_up_chance over the floor's own). Never swarm critters, illusions, boss parts, event monsters or allies. Every ability warns `warn` s before it acts (a ring with a countdown over the fog, a sound). Times in s, distances in px.

blight.name: Blightwalker
blight.text: Leaves pools of blight where it walks

split.name: Splitting
split.text: Splits in two when it dies

ascended._comment: Ascended bosses: from from_depth, or the second time the run meets a boss, it fights ascended: its data's ascended mechanic is added to every phase, health x hp_mult, damage x damage_mult, the title, a halo and aura, and its drops gain extra_drops items and min_rarity_up rarity.
